m438: VYNX processes wallet addresses, aliases, profile details, uploaded images, drafts saved to your account, sponsorship proposals and payment references to run creator pages and verify transactions. Wallet signatures authorize sign-in and actions. Support emails contain the information you choose to send.
m439: Security controls process request metadata and a hashed rate-limit identifier derived from the network address available to the server. Application logs record request identifiers, route, method, status and timing; monitoring records limited failure metadata. These logs are designed to exclude secrets and full request payloads. Hosting and network providers may separately process technical metadata such as IP addresses.
m441: Published creator pages, their links and wallet recipients are public. Alias-to-wallet mappings and blockchain transactions can be viewed independently on Solana. Active sponsorship ads and published offers are public. Private drafts and proposals are accessed through wallet authorization, but uploaded creator images use public URLs: a person with an image URL may still retrieve it after you unpublish a page. Do not upload sensitive images.
m442: Unpublishing a creator card does not automatically remove a separately published sponsorship offer. Blockchain records cannot be erased by deleting application data, and third-party copies or caches may remain.
m444: Essential sign-in cookies hold an opaque 24-hour session token and a short-lived sign-in challenge. The session cookie is HttpOnly and uses SameSite protection; HTTPS deployments use Secure cookies. Signing out revokes the application session.
m445: Local storage holds creator drafts and pending payment references for recovery. A service worker caches static assets. Clearing browser data removes local copies and may remove payment recovery details; keep a transaction signature before doing so. Wallet providers may use their own storage.
m447: VYNX uses Supabase for database and image storage, hosting services to serve the app, Privy for authentication and embedded wallets, Phantom for external wallet connections, Solana RPC services for transaction verification, and Kora for sponsored transaction fees. Configured monitoring destinations receive limited error metadata. These providers process information needed for their services and may operate in different countries. External creator and advertiser links are governed by their own privacy practices.
m448: Profile and payment records remain available to support the account, payment verification and abuse prevention. Expired sessions and challenges no longer authorize access. Monitoring records have a 30-day cleanup policy; actual removal depends on cleanup execution. There is no fixed automatic deletion period for all profile and payment records.
